member.name: T:DotnetClaw.Web.Gateway.TelegramGatewayAdapter
member.summary:
Hosted service that bridges the Telegram channel into the without using a WebSocket — it communicates with the hub directly via method calls.
Responsibilities: • Maintains a per-Telegram-chat session ID so the agent has conversation context. • Accepts inbound Telegram messages via . • Runs the agent turn, streaming agent_chunk / tool_call / tool_result frames to all WebSocket clients subscribed on the "telegram" channel (for real-time observability in the Web UI or CLI). • Sends the final response back to the Telegram chat via the bot client.
Wiring status: ✅ Adapter is implemented and registered as a hosted service. ⚠️ must be called by the Telegram polling layer. The simplest integration is to inject this adapter into and call it alongside TelegramCommandRouter.DispatchAsync, or to replace the router call entirely once the gateway is the canonical agent entry point.
